name: building-blocks-system-shells
title: System Shells
description: System-level Tailwind composition blocks for paired content, shared state wrappers, and density-aware shells.
useWhen: System-level Tailwind composition blocks for paired content, shared state wrappers, and density-aware shells.
avoidWhen: Avoid system shells when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: System Shells uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
